arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_amount_usd, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'NY'
arguments.explanation: Adds up the amounts of all transactions whose merchant location is in New York state, converted from cents to dollars, along with how many transactions that covers.
assumptions: New York state means merchant_locations.state = 'NY' (the two-letter code), not the city of New York or any other location.
All transactions in the period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 are included, whether or not they carry a fraud label.
Negative amounts are included as recorded in the sum, since their meaning is undocumented and they are not treated as refunds.
Transactions with no matching merchant location are excluded by the join.
